hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, re
input_data = json.load(sys.stdin)
params = input_data.get('tool_input', {})
targets = [t for t in (params.get('file_path'), params.get('filePath'), params.get('notebook_path'), params.get('path')) if t]
command = params.get('command', '')
if command:
    targets.extend(re.findall(r'[\\w./~+@-]+', command))
patterns = [
    r'(^|/)\\.env$',
    r'(^|/)\\.env\\.(?!(schema|example)$)',
    r'\\.npmrc$',
    r'\\.keystore$',
    r'\\.jks$',
    r'\\.p12$',
    r'\\.pfx$',
    r'\\.pem$',
    r'\\.key$',
    r'(^|/)id_rsa$',
    r'(^|/)id_ed25519$',
    r'(^|/)id_ecdsa$',
    r'(^|/)id_dsa$',
    r'(^|/)\\.aws/credentials$',
    r'credentials\\.json$',
    r'serviceAccountKey\\.json$',
    r'(^|/)\\.kube/config$',
    r'(^|/)kubeconfig$',
    r'\\.tfstate$',
    r'\\.tfstate\\.backup$',
    r'(^|/)\\.docker/config\\.json$',
    r'(^|/)\\.netrc$',
    r'(^|/)\\.pgpass$'
]
for target in targets:
    if any(re.search(p, target) for p in patterns):
        print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'Sensitive file excluded for security: ' + target}}))
        sys.exit(0)
tool = input_data.get('tool_name') or ''
shell = tool in ('Bash', 'PowerShell', 'Monitor')
sent = {'WebFetch': params.get('url'), 'WebSearch': params.get('query')}.get(tool)
if shell:
    sent = command
elif tool.startswith('mcp__'):
    sent = json.dumps(params, ensure_ascii=False)
if isinstance(sent, str) and sent:
    import os, subprocess
    from urllib.parse import unquote
    low = sent.lower()
    readings = [low, unquote(low).lower()]
    readings += [r.translate({34: None, 39: None, 92: None, 96: None}) for r in readings]
    network = r'[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://|\\b(curl|wget2?|xh|https?|nc|ncat|netcat|socat|telnet|ssh|scp|sftp|ftp|aria2c|lynx|w3m|gh|mailx?|sendmail|send-mailmessage|invoke-webrequest|invoke-restmethod|iwr|irm|requests|urllib|httpx|aiohttp|axios|fetch)\\b'
    computed = shell and re.search(r'user\\.email|emailaddress|oauthaccount', low)
    if (computed or any('@' in r for r in readings)) and (not shell or any(re.search(network, r) for r in readings)):
        addresses = set()
        try:
            found = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', input_data.get('cwd') or '.', 'config', '--get-all', 'user.email'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
            addresses.update(found.stdout.split())
        except Exception:
            pass
        for base in (os.environ.get('CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR'), os.path.expanduser('~')):
            try:
                account = json.load(open(os.path.join(base, '.claude.json'))).get('oauthAccount') or {}
                addresses.add(account.get('emailAddress') or '')
            except Exception:
                pass
        addresses = [a.lower() for a in addresses if '@' in a]
        def scrub(r):
            for a in addresses:
                r = r.replace(a, ' ')
            return r
        held = any(a in r for a in addresses for r in readings)
        if (held or computed) and (not shell or any(re.search(network, scrub(r)) for r in readings)):
            print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'ask', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'This call would send the email address of the user to an outside service. Approve it only if the user asked for the address to be sent; otherwise the agent should identify itself by a generic client name.'}}))
"
